Mechanics learned building steel twister (ride_type 51) in the "coaster" MCP game, rounds 1–2 (Aug 2026):

- Slopes: up_25 = +16 z/tile, up_60 = +64 z/tile; flat_to_up_25 = +8. Turns: left = dir index −1 (2→1→0→3), right = +1. Turn_5 δ from d2: L(2,3)/R(2,−3); turn_3: L(1,2)/R(1,−1); s_bend shifts lane by 1 per 3 tiles.
- Vertical loops must be entered on an up-25 slope (place flat_to_up_25 immediately before); they exit going down-25 and net drift (2,∓1).
- Corkscrew_up + corkscrew_down pair = 180° reversal plus ~3-tile lateral drift, NOT an inline corkscrew. Plan the turn-around around it or skip.
- left_turn_1/right_turn_1 have no artwork for type 51 — they place but render invisible and get rejected.
- Circuit closes when a final flat's endpoint lands exactly ON the begin_station tile at matching z/bank/slope. A track passing OVER the station at higher z does not close and doesn't collide either.
- Z datum is not stable between demolish/rebuild cycles (saw 112 vs 96 baselines) — always steer closure from live cursor reads, never from remembered heights.
- Map is not the documented rectangle: there is a large central circular pond and the shore bulges; "partly above/below water" errors fire when dips go under surface. Crossing water is fine at altitude (≥ ~32 above the low datum).
- Intensity > 10 tanks excitement: a fast unbraked train hit lat G 3.66 / negG −2.43 → excitement 2.13 despite 3 inversions. Brake clusters (speed 14–20) before tight unbanked turns/corkscrew cut lateral G to 1.5.
- Opposite trap: brakes with no boosters/drops afterwards make the train crawl — ride_time explodes and ratings come back null with tested:false even at 60k ticks. Every braked section needs a booster or a big drop after it.
- Round results: R1 = 5.6 (90 pcs, no inversions); R2 best = 2.13 (138 pcs, 3 inversions, but intensity 14.9).
